name: Alter
description: Skirmisher who breaches terrain and provides a squad recall point.

passive.description.value: Reveals nearby death boxes through walls and allows Alter to remotely take one item from each box.

tactical.description.value: Creates a passage through a valid wall, floor, or ceiling that Legends can traverse to the opposite side.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys a recall point that Alter and her squad can activate remotely to phase back to it; the resulting chase portal can also be used by enemies.

provenance.evidence: Overclocked notes specify Alter's current tactical cooldown and ultimate range and recall timings.

name: Ash
description: Skirmisher built around a burst movement passive, tether pressure, and one-way team repositioning.

passive.description.value: Performs an omnidirectional short-range air dash, enabling mid-fight repositioning or gap closing.

tactical.description.value: Throws a spinning snare that damages and tethers an enemy near its impact point, limiting escape until the tether ends or breaks.

ultimate.description.value: Opens a one-way phase portal to a targeted location for Ash, allies, and enemies who enter it.

provenance.evidence: Overclocked notes specify Ash's current passive cooldown and velocity.

name: Axle
description: Combat Racer whose slide control, team-agnostic speed gate, and seeking displacement drone shape engagement timing.

passive.description.value: Gives Axle increased speed, acceleration, and lateral control while sliding.

tactical.description.value: Deploys a team-agnostic gate that forces anyone crossing it into a high-speed, highly steerable boosted slide.

ultimate.description.value: Launches a ground-running drone that searches for a target, chases it, then detonates to damage, reveal, stun, and displace affected enemies.

provenance.evidence: Marked notes reduce Nitro Gate's maximum slide boost to 3 seconds and define Kickstart effects on Axle and allies.

name: Ballistic
description: Assault Legend who carries a sling weapon, pressures enemy weapons, and boosts squad weapon readiness.

passive.description.value: Carries a third weapon in the Sling; the Sling weapon improves with Legend level and can hold Care Package weapons.

tactical.description.value: Fires a guided Smart Bullet that pressures the target's weapon and causes an overheat burst if they keep firing; missed bullets remain as an area hazard.

ultimate.description.value: Empowers the squad with faster reloads, movement speed, and unlimited ammunition while upgrading Ballistic's Sling weapon for the duration.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Ballistic as an Assault Legend; ability roles are recorded for review lookup.

name: Catalyst
description: Controller who reinforces doors, places ferrofluid traps, and blocks sightlines with Dark Veil.

passive.description.value: Reinforces doors with ferrofluid, increasing the effort required to break them and allowing Catalyst to control blocked doorways.

tactical.description.value: Throws a ferrofluid spike trap that activates near enemies, damaging and slowing movement through its area.

ultimate.description.value: Raises a long permeable ferrofluid wall that blocks sightlines and impairs enemies who cross it.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Catalyst as a Controller Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Caustic
description: Controller who uses gas traps and a gas grenade to deny enclosed space.

passive.description.value: Allows Caustic to see enemies affected by his Nox gas through the gas.

tactical.description.value: Places canisters that release damaging Nox gas when enemies approach or when the canister is triggered.

ultimate.description.value: Throws a grenade that blankets a large area in Nox gas for sustained area denial.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Caustic as a Controller Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Conduit
description: Support Legend who accelerates toward allies and grants temporary shields with two tactical charges.

passive.description.value: Gains sprint speed when moving toward a squadmate outside tactical range, with an additional bonus when moving toward a Skirmisher.

tactical.description.value: Regenerates temporary shields for a targeted ally and Conduit without requiring direct line of sight for the full regeneration; currently has two charges.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys shield-jamming devices across an area that damage shields and slow enemies who remain inside their fields.

provenance.evidence: Overclocked notes define Conduit's two tactical charges, regeneration duration/rate, cooldown, and passive bonus toward Skirmishers.

name: Crypto
description: Recon Legend who scouts remotely with a drone and disrupts shields and deployables with an EMP.

passive.description.value: Shares enemies and objects detected by Crypto's drone with Crypto and his squad.

tactical.description.value: Deploys and pilots a surveillance drone for remote scouting, scanning, banner interactions, and other drone-enabled interactions.

ultimate.description.value: Detonates an EMP from the drone that damages shields, slows players, and disables or destroys many deployable defenses.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Crypto as a Recon Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Fuse
description: Assault Legend specializing in carried ordnance, Knuckle Cluster pressure, and large-area artillery denial.

passive.description.value: Stacks additional grenades and launches ordnance farther, faster, and more accurately with the arm-mounted launcher.

tactical.description.value: Fires a cluster charge that sticks to surfaces or targets and produces a sequence of explosions.

ultimate.description.value: Fires a mortar that can pierce cover before impact and scatters explosive submunitions across a broad area.

provenance.evidence: Breach patch notes document Fuse's current reworked tactical and ultimate direction.

name: Gibraltar
description: Support Legend who protects peeks and resets with a gun shield and dome, then denies an area with bombardment.

passive.description.value: Deploys a forward-facing gun shield while aiming down sights, absorbing incoming fire until broken.

tactical.description.value: Throws a dome that blocks incoming and outgoing attacks, creating a temporary protected space for fights and resets.

ultimate.description.value: Calls a concentrated mortar strike onto a marked position, damaging and stunning exposed enemies.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Gibraltar as a Support Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Horizon
description: Skirmisher who reduces landing disruption, lifts players vertically, and groups enemies with a black hole.

passive.description.value: Improves airborne control and reduces the movement penalty from hard landings.

tactical.description.value: Creates a gravity column that lifts players upward, enabling vertical repositioning while also being usable by enemies.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys N.E.W.T. to create a black hole that pulls nearby players and ordnance toward its center.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Horizon as a Skirmisher Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Loba
description: Support Legend who sees valuable loot, teleports with her bracelet, and supplies the squad through Black Market.

passive.description.value: Reveals nearby high-tier loot through obstacles, helping Loba identify valuable equipment before entering an area.

tactical.description.value: Throws a bracelet and teleports Loba to its landing point for repositioning, entry, or escape.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys a Black Market that lets nearby players transfer loot from the surrounding area into their inventories.

provenance.evidence: Marked notes define Loba's tactical equip/range/travel changes and 120-second ultimate cooldown.

name: Mad Maggie
description: Assault Legend who highlights damaged targets, drills through cover, and creates an aggressive speed route.

passive.description.value: Temporarily highlights enemies Maggie damages and removes the normal movement penalty while carrying shotguns.

tactical.description.value: Fires a drill that attaches to an obstacle and burns enemies on the opposite side of the cover.

ultimate.description.value: Throws a ball that travels through the environment, disrupts enemies and obstacles, and leaves speed-boosting pads behind.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Mad Maggie as an Assault Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Mirage
description: Support Legend who uses decoys and cloaking during revives and respawns to create uncertainty.

passive.description.value: Cloaks Mirage and the teammate he revives, cloaks Mirage while using a Respawn Beacon, and enables direct control of deployed decoys.

tactical.description.value: Sends out a holographic decoy that can be directed or made to mimic Mirage's movement to draw reactions and reveal attackers.

ultimate.description.value: Briefly cloaks Mirage and deploys a group of controllable decoys that mimic him, obscuring which target is real.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Mirage as a Support Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Newcastle
description: Support Legend who drags downed allies behind a shield and deploys mobile and fortification shields.

passive.description.value: Drags a downed squadmate while reviving and protects the revive with Newcastle's knockdown-shield energy.

tactical.description.value: Deploys a mobile energy shield whose position and facing can be redirected after placement.

ultimate.description.value: Leaps to a target location or squadmate and slams down a fortified wall that creates durable cover.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Newcastle as a Support Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Octane
description: Skirmisher who regenerates health, trades health for speed, and launches the squad through the air.

passive.description.value: Regenerates missing health over time when Octane is not taking damage.

tactical.description.value: Consumes health to gain a burst of movement speed and reduce the effect of movement slows for a short duration.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys a reusable jump pad that launches any player who touches it and permits an aerial direction change.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Octane as a Skirmisher Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Rampart
description: Controller who improves LMG handling, builds amped cover, and supplies mobile minigun pressure.

passive.description.value: Improves magazine capacity and reload or handling performance for LMGs and Sheila, and accelerates Locked Hop-Up progress.

tactical.description.value: Builds crouch-height cover with an upper amped barrier that blocks incoming fire and increases outgoing weapon damage.

ultimate.description.value: Equips Sheila, a high-capacity mobile minigun that spins up into sustained high-rate fire and can be placed for later use.

provenance.evidence: Marked notes define Rampart's hop-up progress, wall health/deployment changes, and Sheila movement speed.

name: Revenant
description: Assault Legend who tracks vulnerable enemies, leaps to engage, and gains a rechargeable shadow guard.

passive.description.value: Highlights nearby enemies who are low on health and improves crouch movement and climbing for stalking or pursuit.

tactical.description.value: Charges and releases a long forward leap whose distance increases with charge time.

ultimate.description.value: Creates a shadow shroud that absorbs damage and can be refreshed after securing a knock.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Revenant as an Assault Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.

name: Seer
description: Recon Legend who detects nearby heartbeats, interrupts and reveals with his tactical, and tracks movement in a large area.

passive.description.value: Detects the direction and approximate presence of nearby heartbeats while aiming down sights or preparing the tactical.

tactical.description.value: Emits a delayed focused blast that reveals affected enemies and disrupts their actions and ability use.

ultimate.description.value: Deploys a device that reveals enemy movement and firing activity within a large surrounding area.

provenance.evidence: Marked notes retain the July 2 Home Base cooldown at 8 seconds and reduce tactical turn slow without publishing an absolute amount.

name: Sparrow
description: Recon Legend who double-jumps, places line-of-sight tracker darts, and fires an area-denial Stinger Bolt.

passive.description.value: Performs a second jump in mid-air or launches upward from a climb, and carries additional standard and explosive Bocek arrows.

tactical.description.value: Fires a surface-mounted tracker that reveals enemies entering its line of sight and can remotely activate Survey Beacons.

ultimate.description.value: Fires an anchored large arrow that charges and repeatedly shocks its area, damaging and slowing enemies until they leave cover, escape the radius, or destroy it.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Sparrow as a Recon Legend; current core ability functions are documented in official Prodigy notes.

name: Valkyrie
description: Recon Legend using jet-assisted vertical movement, missile pressure, and squad redeployment.

passive.description.value: Uses VTOL jets for controlled vertical flight and scans visible enemies while skydiving.

tactical.description.value: Launches a grid of rockets that damage and briefly stun enemies caught in the impact pattern.

ultimate.description.value: Prepares a vertical launch that allows Valkyrie and attached squadmates to redeploy by skydive.

provenance.evidence: Marked notes define Valkyrie's missile damage, ultimate height reduction, scan ranges, and Supersonic modifier.

name: Vantage
description: Recon sniper who reads squads through Spotter's Lens, repositions with Echo, and marks targets with a custom rifle.

review.availabilityRequirement.value: Confirm the HUD state and prior use at the decision timestamp; cooldown alone is insufficient evidence of availability.

passive.description.value: Uses Spotter's Lens to inspect distant enemies and teams, estimate bullet drop, and build ultimate ammunition by tracking teams.

tactical.description.value: Commands Echo to a location and launches Vantage toward him, with an optional second jump for additional repositioning.

ultimate.description.value: Equips a custom sniper rifle whose hits mark targets and increase follow-up damage against them; it supports normal and canted sight modes.

provenance.evidence: Overclocked notes specify Vantage's passive generation, Echo movement/cooldown, and both Sniper's Mark scope modes.

name: Wattson
description: Controller who regenerates shields, fences routes, and intercepts ordnance while restoring shields.

passive.description.value: Passively regenerates shields and allows Wattson to carry additional Ultimate Accelerants and use one to fully charge her ultimate.

tactical.description.value: Connects fence nodes into electrified barriers that damage, slow, and reveal enemies crossing them.

ultimate.description.value: Places a pylon that intercepts incoming ordnance and restores shields to players within its effective area.

provenance.evidence: EA's current roster identifies Wattson as a Controller Legend; core ability functions are recorded for review lookup.
